notes.title: Farjob now on Mac!
notes.content:
It's already been a little over a year since the release of Farjob! [i]Dang.[/i] I figured the least I could do was finally make a Mac version. 

Really, thanks for trying Farjob!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33363832/576ae3a88ffaa44d381d61731b5d2de1aa2f80fc.png[/img]

notes.title: Farjob is now free!
notes.content:
Unfortunately, only 4 people purchased Farjob during the Halloween Sale and Halljobween Hex update. My greatest goal with Farjob is to get as much feedback as possible. Therefore, I have decided to  give the game a 100% discount forever. Enjoy!

-Simon 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33363832/09972a51d84b31084c5501c1d67bf1ddcbafbb16.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33363832/4c8c3d7c382fe9c91c59065127fa6b1a8a749dc6.png[/img][/url]
[i]Who says there's no such thing as a free lunch?[/i]

notes.title: Halljobween Hex is now live!
notes.content:
Are you prepared? Prepared to be...scared?
[i]Mwahahaha[/i]

Halljobween Hex is the first ever Farjob BONUS CONTENT! In Bonus Content, you can expect to see interesting mechanics and characters that didn't make it into the original game. I hope that old players will keep coming back to see what's new. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33363832/8b8c2a36510b70b7129b4f703bb02008052b6a73.gif[/img]
[i]Who is this strange man? He looks like he has a job for you...[/i]
